scenes.text: The free app blocker already on your phone — that nobody uses right.

scenes.title: Set limits on your 2 worst apps.
scenes.body: **Screen Time** on iPhone, **Digital Wellbeing** on Android.

scenes.title: Block at the end of the limit.
scenes.body: So the limit **actually stops you,** not just reminds you.

scenes.title: Hand the passcode to someone else.
scenes.body: Partner, friend, roommate. **They type it — you never see it.**

scenes.title: Agree on one rule.
scenes.body: They unlock it **only for real reasons** — not "just 5 more minutes."
